### The Feast of Trumpets
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/feast-trumpets
Passage: Leviticus 23:24
Points:
- God instituted sacred feasts to prompt His people to remember His goodness and their salvation.
- Trumpet blasts served to gather the community and build anticipation for God's powerful self-revelation.
- The blowing of the shofar recalled God's provision of the ram for Isaac, foreshadowing a greater sacrifice.
- Christ has inaugurated the last days, pointing forward to the ultimate fulfillment of the feast.
- Believers are urged to proclaim the gospel faithfully before the final trumpet sounds.

### Happy New Year! …In September?
Author: Dallas Paetzold
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/happy-new-year-in-september-encouragement-caf-october-13-2014.html
Passage: Leviticus 23:24-25
Points:
- God commanded Israel to pause from labor and gather for a sacred convocation announced by trumpets.
- The blast of the ram's horn commemorates God providing a substitute ram to deliver Isaac on Mount Moriah.
- Jesus serves as the ultimate sacrificial Lamb, securing eternal forgiveness rather than yearly atonement.
- The sounding of the trumpet prophetically anticipates the return of Christ as King of Kings.
- Believers are called to celebrate that their names are written in the Book of Life and look eagerly for Jesus' return.
